Question 2
?

Consider the two sets of 7 paired observations shown in the table below.


xi 1.2 1.0 0.7 1.3 1.81.7 1.4
yi 6.6 6.1 5.7 6.0 6.3 5.9 5.4

Calculate Sxy.

a
 Sxy=0.06
b
 Sxy=1.12
c
 Sxy=2.80
d
 Sxy=0.14
e
 Sxy=1.33
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Given a set of n paired observations x1,x2,…,xn and y1,y2,…,yn, Sxy is the sum of products of the deviations of xi and yi from their respective means, that is Sxy=∑i=1n(xi−x―)(yi−y―).

First, we calculate the sample means x― and y―: x―=1.2+1.0+0.7+1.3+1.8+1.4+1.77=1.3 y―=6.6+6.1+5.7+6.0+6.3+5.9+5.47=6

Next, we calculate the differences between the xi and x―, yi and y―, and their product.


xi 1.2 1.0 0.7 1.3 1.81.7 1.4
yi 6.6 6.1 5.7 6.0 6.3 5.9 5.4
(xi−x―) −0.1 −0.3 −0.6 0 0.5 0.4 0.1
(yi−y―) 0.6 0.1 −0.3 0 0.3 −0.1 −0.6
(xi−x―)(yi−y―) −0.06 −0.03 0.18 0 0.15 −0.04 −0.06

Therefore, Sxy is Sxy=(−0.06)+(−0.03)+0.18+0+0.15+(−0.04)+(−0.06)=0.14.
